rundown: Magic beat Bucks 107-99 at Kia Center in Orlando, FL in front of 19,140. Magic led 52-37 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Magic won it 23-15. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 76%).
Leading the way — Bucks: Jaime Jaquez Jr. 22 pts, 4 ast; Myles Turner 11 reb. Magic: Franz Wagner 35 pts, 12 ast, 9 reb.
Where Magic won it: they shot 45% to 39%, had 29 assists to 20 and turned it over 13 times to 15.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Magic closed as 9.5-point favorites and won but didn't cover (Bucks +9.5 cashed); the total closed at 223.5 and they combined for 206, under by 17.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 13, 6:55 PM ET. It had Bucks 18% and Magic 82%, projecting Bucks 105 – Magic 116 (221 total, Magic by 11).

Final: Bucks 99 – Magic 107. Right winner: it had Magic at 82%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bucks came in with a 3% below average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (1-11, 106.8 scored and 121.3 allowed a game over 12 games), worth about 73 and 74 games of evidence. Projected to score 105, they scored 99 (−6 points, 6% under); projected to allow 116, they allowed 107 (−9 points, 8% under).

Magic came in with a 2% below average attack and a league-average defense (4-7, 108.5 scored and 114 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 67 and 67 games of evidence. Projected to score 116, they scored 107 (−9 points, 8% under); projected to allow 105, they allowed 99 (−6 points, 6% under).

The bigger miss was Magic's scoring (-9 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 206 against 221 projected (-15), about the 20th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Magic by 8 against Magic by 11 projected, about the 40th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
ORL ML (-423) at -423: the algo gave it 78% vs 78% fair (+0.5 pts) — won (+0.2u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 78%). MIL ML (+331) at +331: the algo gave it 22% vs 22% fair (-0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 22%). ORL -9.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. MIL +9.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 224.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 48% vs 49% fair (-0.7 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the closing 223.5 by 1. UNDER 224.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 52% vs 51% fair (+0.7 pts) — won (+0.9u); beat the closing 223.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: total 224.5 → 223.5. The total moved toward the algo's number.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 41% of bets on Bucks, 59% of the money — Bucks covered; total: 77% of bets on the over, 72% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 6% of bets on Bucks, 18% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Bucks, who lost and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.926 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -2.6 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 68 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.992 and gives home teams +0.4 points. Team corrections so far: Bucks attack ×0.976, defense ×0.994 (6 games); Magic attack ×0.999, defense ×0.995 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
